info.title: Tiralarc API
info.description: Public API consumed by the web app and the mobile apps.

locale.description: Language of the emails sent to the user.

verificationRequired.description: Always true: a confirmation link was emailed; login is refused until it is used.

token.description: Token from the link emailed at registration.

deviceName.description: Human-readable device label (e.g. "Pixel 9", "Firefox on Linux"), shown in session lists.

refreshToken.description: Opaque, single-use token exchanged at /auth/refresh for a new pair.

deviceName.description: Human-readable device label (e.g. "Pixel 9", "Firefox on Linux"), shown in session lists.

idToken.description: ID token returned by Google Identity Services / Sign in with Apple (web or native SDK).

nonce.description: Nonce passed to the provider when requesting the token; checked if present.

displayName.description: Apple only sends the name to the client, on first sign-in: forward it here.

deviceName.description: Human-readable device label (e.g. "Pixel 9", "Firefox on Linux"), shown in session lists.

Role.description: Nobody picks their roles: every account is ARCHER; COACH while an archer's coach invitation the user accepted still exists; ADMIN is granted by an administrator.

roles.description: Nobody picks their roles: every account is ARCHER; COACH while an archer's coach invitation the user accepted still exists; ADMIN is granted by an administrator.

hasPassword.description: False for accounts created through Google / Apple only.

ThemeBand.description: Which band was clicked: one of the theme's artwork bands, or `title` (the month's name in hollow letters, drawn by the client).

band.description: Which band was clicked: one of the theme's artwork bands, or `title` (the month's name in hollow letters, drawn by the client).

x.description: Horizontal position in the band image (0 = left).

y.description: Vertical position in the band image (0 = top).

theme.description: Theme id; each client maps it to its own artwork. Null: no decoration, only the month's name is coloured.

fills.description: The archer's colouring of that month (decoration bands and name), in the order it was painted.

stars.description: The archer's overall satisfaction with the month, in stars (0.5 to 5, by halves).

monthThemes.description: Decoration of the calendar, for the months that have one (oldest first).

monthSatisfactions.description: Satisfaction of the months the archer rated (oldest first).

sessionCount.description: Number of the archer's events dated within the period.

isDefault.description: The journal to open at sign-in. At most one of the archer's journals has it.

endDate.description: Last day, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Not before `startDate`; the period must not overlap another of the archer's journals.
Last day, inclusive. The period must not overlap another of the archer's journals.

isDefault.description: true makes it the archer's default journal (the one opened at sign-in) in place of any other; false leaves no default.

theme.description: Theme id, or null to remove the decoration of that month. Changing or removing it clears the artwork bands' colouring; the `title` band (the month's name) keeps its own.

stars.description: Stars (0.5 to 5, by halves), or null: the month is not rated.

color.description: Colour of its events in the calendars (the season overview draws them in it).

icon.description: Pictogram of its events in the month calendar.

arrowCount.description: Arrows shot (clients add them up, e.g. for the month shown).

description.description: Analyses, or the text of an `OTHER` event.

customType.description: `CUSTOM` events only: their type, whose title, colour and pictogram they show.

completed.description: Whether the review of a training, coaching or competition is written: at least one of arrowCount, score, satisfaction, technique, description, physicalFeeling, mentalFeeling, wentWell, toImprove, nextTime is filled. Always true for the other types (nothing to review). Clients fill the review only once the day has come.

plannedByCoach.description: Whether the archer's coach planned the event (see `SessionDto.plannedBy`). Clients mark it until the archer completes it.

fftaCompetitionId.description: The FFTA competition it was added from (`CompetitionDto.id`), if any.

count.description: Events of that type on that day.
Events of that day with that feeling.

arrows.description: Arrows shot that day, all types of events together.

minutes.description: Minutes spent that day, all types of events together.

scores.description: Trainings, coachings and competitions with both a score and a discipline, oldest first.

eventsByDay.description: Number of events per day and type (days with events only), oldest first.

physicalFeelingsByDay.description: Physical feeling of the events, counted per day (events with one only), oldest first.

mentalFeelingsByDay.description: Mental feeling of the events, counted per day (events with one only), oldest first.

arrowsByDay.description: Days with a recorded number of arrows, oldest first.

durationsByDay.description: Days with a recorded duration, oldest first.

arrowCount.description: Arrows shot (clients add them up, e.g. for the month shown).

description.description: Analyses, or the text of an `OTHER` event.

customType.description: `CUSTOM` events only: their type, whose title, colour and pictogram they show.

completed.description: Whether the review of a training, coaching or competition is written: at least one of arrowCount, score, satisfaction, technique, description, physicalFeeling, mentalFeeling, wentWell, toImprove, nextTime is filled. Always true for the other types (nothing to review). Clients fill the review only once the day has come.

plannedByCoach.description: Whether the archer's coach planned the event (see `SessionDto.plannedBy`). Clients mark it until the archer completes it.

fftaCompetitionId.description: The FFTA competition it was added from (`CompetitionDto.id`), if any.

customTypeId.description: Required for a `CUSTOM` event (one of the archer's event types), ignored otherwise.

location.description: Prefilled place (e.g. a competition added from the FFTA calendar).

fftaCompetitionId.description: A `COMPETITION` added from the FFTA calendar: that competition's id (`CompetitionDto.id`). At most 2 events of one competition per day (`LIMIT_REACHED`). Ignored for other types.

arrowCount.description: Arrows shot (clients add them up, e.g. for the month shown).

description.description: Analyses, or the text of an `OTHER` event.

customType.description: `CUSTOM` events only: their type, whose title, colour and pictogram they show.

completed.description: Whether the review of a training, coaching or competition is written: at least one of arrowCount, score, satisfaction, technique, description, physicalFeeling, mentalFeeling, wentWell, toImprove, nextTime is filled. Always true for the other types (nothing to review). Clients fill the review only once the day has come.

plannedByCoach.description: Whether the archer's coach planned the event (see `SessionDto.plannedBy`). Clients mark it until the archer completes it.

fftaCompetitionId.description: The FFTA competition it was added from (`CompetitionDto.id`), if any.

plannedBy.description: The coach who planned the event in the archer's journal; null when the archer created it. That coach may change its planning or delete it while it is still to come.

title.description: Title of an `OTHER` event, shown in the calendar.

url.description: Resized image (2000 px on its longest side at most).

width.description: Width of the resized image, in pixels.

height.description: Height of the resized image, in pixels.

file.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 10 MB max.

id.description: The FFTA's id of the competition.

discipline.description: The archer's discipline it belongs to: outdoor target archery is TAE_NATIONAL unless the archer practises only TAE_INTERNATIONAL.

url.description: Its page on the FFTA website.

dismissed.description: The archer said they will not take part (PUT .../dismissal): left out of the competitions to plan; the calendars still show it.

mandateUrl.description: The organiser's invitation ("mandat", PDF), once published.

department.description: The archer's department (profile); null = none chosen, hence no competitions.

competitions.description: The department's competitions in the archer's disciplines (profile) that have not ended yet and touch the requested days, by first day.

complete.description: False when the FFTA website could not be read for some of the disciplines: the list may miss competitions (try again later).

url.description: The results published by the organiser on the FFTA website (PDF); null until they are (or when the FFTA website could not be read).

RankingField.description: Profile fields to fill in first: licence number, category, bow.

season.description: The FFTA season it ranks: the current one, or the one before.

discipline.description: The archer's discipline it ranks: outdoor target archery is the archer's TAE discipline (when they practise both, TAE_INTERNATIONAL for its distances: 70 m, or 50 m on an 80 cm face for a compound).

distance.description: Outdoor target archery: each distance has its ranking.

scores.description: The best scores counted, best first as the FFTA lists them.

url.description: The ranking on the FFTA website.

season.description: The current FFTA season (null when not read).

missing.description: Profile fields to fill in first: licence number, category, bow.

rankings.description: The rankings of the archer's category and bow, in their disciplines, that list their licence (scratch rankings left out): the current season first, then the one before (also searched one category younger).

complete.description: False when the FFTA website could not be read in full: try again later.

Indicator.description: The indicator shown on the home page; null = none.

calendarFont.description: Font of the calendars' weekdays and day numbers: an id each client maps to its own font; null = the client's default.

favoriteIndicator.description: The indicator shown on the home page; null = none.

department.description: Department code (see GET /competitions/departments) whose FFTA competitions the calendars show; null = none.

paraCompetitions.description: Also show the para-archery competitions (indoor and outdoor target archery).

calendarFont.description: Font id of the calendars; null goes back to the client's default.

favoriteIndicator.description: The indicator shown on the home page; null for none.

department.description: Department code (see GET /competitions/departments); null for none.

CoachAccess.description: Coaches only. What the coach may do in the archer's journal of the season in progress (the one whose period covers today): READ = see all of it, plus the indicators and goals; WRITE = READ, and plan future trainings, coachings, competitions and strength sessions.

InvitationStatus.description: A coach has ACCEPTED once linked to an account (and then has access).

coachAccess.description: Coaches only. What the coach may do in the archer's journal of the season in progress (the one whose period covers today): READ = see all of it, plus the indicators and goals; WRITE = READ, and plan future trainings, coachings, competitions and strength sessions.

status.description: A coach has ACCEPTED once linked to an account (and then has access).

isCoach.description: True when the guest is the archer's coach: accepting (signed in) gives them `coachAccess`. Otherwise the guest is only invited to discover the site.

coachAccess.description: What the coach may do in the archer's journal of the season in progress (the one whose period covers today): READ = see all of it, plus the indicators and goals; WRITE = READ, and plan future trainings, coachings, competitions and strength sessions. Ignored unless `isCoach`.

locale.description: Language of the invitation email; the archer's own language when omitted.

coachAccess.description: What the coach may do in the archer's journal of the season in progress (the one whose period covers today): READ = see all of it, plus the indicators and goals; WRITE = READ, and plan future trainings, coachings, competitions and strength sessions.

invitedBy.description: Display name (or email) of the archer who sent the invitation.

archerId.description: Coach invitations: the archer's id (see /coach/athletes/{archerId}); null for a plain guest.

achieved.description: True once the goal has a day it was reached.

createdOn.description: Day the goal was set (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

achievedOn.description: Day the goal was reached (YYYY-MM-DD); omitted / null = not reached yet.

journal.description: The archer's journal of the season in progress (its period covers today): the only one the coach sees. Null when there is none.

disciplines.description: The disciplines the archer practises (their profile), offered when planning.

date.description: A day after today, within the archer's journal of the season in progress.

fftaCompetitionId.description: A `COMPETITION` added from the FFTA calendar (GET .../competitions): that competition's id. At most 2 events of one competition per day (`LIMIT_REACHED`). Ignored for other types.

date.description: A day after today, within the archer's journal of the season in progress.
